description: Generates a sound effect from a text prompt alone with MMAudio (large 44.1 kHz v2) and saves it as a 44.1 kHz mono wav. 'prompt' says what should be heard ('a heavy wooden door creaks open, then slams'); 'duration' is 8 s by default, at most 20 s, and the model was trained around 8 s, so it warns outside 4-12 s. The effect runs 7-25 dB hot: route it through match_levels before mixing it with dialogue or music. For effects that follow a clip's picture, use the video-to-sound-effects template. summary: A sound effect from a text prompt (MMAudio), as a 44.1 kHz mono wav.
